front.title: An Experiment: Mapping IETF Device YANG Models to Vendors

abstract.t: This document describes an experimental implementation of a YANG to YANG translation function layer providing a northbound interface for configuring networking devices using a set of IETF 'device' YANG modules. The southbound interface of the function implements the proprietary, vendor YANG modules which are implemented natively on devices to be configured. The expected benefits of such an approach are the ability to provide a stable, standardised, and vendor/device agnostic interface for the configuration and maintenance of devices. The main purposes for this experiment is to validate the overall approach, and to identify, and describe the different YANG-to-YANG translation techniques that can be used.
